02 // THE SYSTEM

Classification Is Not Morality

The city ranks Kin by institutional desirability. The system measures usefulness and acceptance—not goodness, truth, or worth.

01CLASSIFICATION
Platinum

Elite institutional trust, near-total access, wealth or power families, and major civic influence.

02CLASSIFICATION
Gold

Highly trusted, with privileged access and strong social standing.

03CLASSIFICATION
Silver

Respected, stable, and broadly protected.

04CLASSIFICATION
Bronze

A normal working citizen with standard access.

05CLASSIFICATION
Copper

Lower-middle standing, with some scrutiny or reduced benefits.

06CLASSIFICATION
Yellow

Flagged or unstable standing, restricted opportunities, and increased scrutiny.

07CLASSIFICATION
Orange

Marginalized and outside the scope of many agencies and services.

08CLASSIFICATION
Red

Heavily restricted: high-risk classification and severe institutional exclusion.

09CLASSIFICATION
Purple

Deeply stigmatized or anomalous, under special controls.

10CLASSIFICATION
Black

Effectively untouchable, condemned, and excluded by the system.

11CLASSIFICATION
No Category

Not recognized by the system at all—which may be worse than Black.

QUESTION

Something does not fit.

The contradiction becomes the first piece of evidence.

INVESTIGATION

The system pushes back.

ANSWER
